name: cache-warm
description: Keeps the prompt cache of idle Claude Code sessions warm. Works the same in the CLI, IDE and Desktop app; per-session, per-project, per-surface and global settings.

enabled.title: Warming on
enabled.description: Global master switch. Per-surface, per-project and per-session settings can override it (ccw or the dashboard).

warm_when.title: Warm a session
warm_when.description: background-work: only while a subagent, background task or scheduled task is pending (recommended). always: any idle session.

interval_minutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: Counted from the conversation's last request. auto = 50 on a 1-hour cache, 4 on a 5-minute cache. Otherwise 1 to 59, shorter than the cache TTL.

max_idle_minutes.title: Stop after idle (minutes)
max_idle_minutes.description: Stop pinging once nobody has typed and no real work has happened for this long. 0 = never stop.

min_context_tokens.title: Skip sessions below (tokens)
min_context_tokens.description: Small contexts are cheap to rebuild; do not warm them.

desktop_mode.title: Desktop app sessions
desktop_mode.description: same-as-cli: follow the settings above. off / background-work / always: override them for sessions in the Claude desktop app only.

statusline.title: Status line segment
statusline.description: auto: add the cache segment to your status line (creating one if you have none). wrap-only: only add it to an existing status line. off: remove it and restore your original status line exactly.
